faq.q: How much does Brooklyn Defender Services charge?
faq.a: Brooklyn Defender Services publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Brooklyn Defender Services offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Brooklyn Defender Services does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking.

faq.q: Where does Brooklyn Defender Services have offices?
faq.a: Brooklyn Defender Services publishes one office, in Brooklyn. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Brooklyn Defender Services?
faq.a: Brooklyn Defender Services names two attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Brooklyn Defender Services?
faq.a: Brooklyn Defender Services scores 25 and sits at Listed. Passed: entity registration, website and footprint. Did not pass: licensure and discipline.
